SELECT ro.id, ro.nickname, ro.user_phone, ro.address, ro.category_name, ro.description, ro.expect_time, ro.remark, ro.create_time, ro.feedback, -- 获取最新的维修记录信息 latest_rr.rr_id, latest_rr.repairman_name, latest_rr.repair_time, latest_rr.repair_process, latest_rr.status, -- 统计该报修单有多少条维修记录（用于前端判断是否有历史） record_count.total_count FROM repair_order ro -- 获取每个报修单最新的维修记录（子查询） LEFT JOIN ( SELECT rr1.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY rr1.update_time DESC, rr1.rr_id DESC) as rn FROM repair_record rr1 ) latest_rr ON ro.id = latest_rr.order_id AND latest_rr.rn = 1 -- 统计每个报修单的维修记录总数（子查询） LEFT JOIN ( SELECT order_id, COUNT(*) as total_count FROM repair_record GROUP BY order_id ) record_count ON ro.id = record_count.order_id
and ro.id like concat('%',#{id},'%')
and ro.address like concat('%',#{address},'%')
and latest_rr.repairman_name like concat('%',#{repairmanName},'%')
and ro.nickname like concat('%',#{nickName},'%')
and latest_rr.status = #{status}
and latest_rr.repair_time like concat(#{repairTime}, '%')
ORDER BY ro.create_time DESC

select ro.id, ro.nickname, ro.user_phone, ro.address, ro.category_name, ro.description, ro.expect_time, ro.remark, ro.create_time, ro.feedback, rr.rr_id ,rr.repairman_name, rr.repair_time, rr.repair_process, rr.status from repair_record rr inner join repair_order ro on rr.order_id = ro.id where ro.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY rr.repair_time DESC
SELECT id, nickname, user_phone, address, category_name, description, expect_time, remark, feedback, create_time FROM repair_order WHERE id = #{orderId}

SELECT ro.address, COUNT(ro.id) AS count FROM repair_order ro INNER JOIN repair_record rr ON ro.id = rr.order_id
GROUP BY ro.address ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT DATE(rr.repair_time) AS date, COUNT(ro.id) AS count FROM repair_order ro INNER JOIN repair_record rr ON ro.id = rr.order_id
AND rr.repair_time IS NOT NULL GROUP BY DATE(rr.repair_time) ORDER BY date ASC

SELECT rr.status, CASE WHEN rr.status = 0 THEN '待处理' WHEN rr.status = 1 THEN '处理中' WHEN rr.status = 2 THEN '已完成' WHEN rr.status = 3 THEN '已取消' WHEN rr.status = 4 THEN '待转发' END AS statusName, COUNT(ro.id) AS count FROM repair_order ro INNER JOIN repair_record rr ON ro.id = rr.order_id
GROUP BY rr.status ORDER BY rr.status ASC

SELECT COUNT(ro.id) AS totalCount, SUM(CASE WHEN rr.status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pendingCount, SUM(CASE WHEN rr.status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS processingCount, SUM(CASE WHEN rr.status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completedCount, SUM(CASE WHEN rr.status = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancelledCount, SUM(CASE WHEN rr.status = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pendingTransferCount FROM repair_order ro INNER JOIN repair_record rr ON ro.id = rr.order_id
